name: Ecuadorian Cacao Chocolate
about: This is bean-to-bar chocolate made from Ecuadorian cacao. Ecuador is one of the world's known cacao origins, and Quito is a good place to find local makers.
tip: Pick a flavor with local fruit or salt, and check the label for the cacao percentage.

name: Toquilla Straw Hat
about: This is a hand-woven hat from toquilla palm fiber. Despite the name, the Panama hat comes from Ecuador, and the craft is still strong in the country.
tip: Check that the weave is tight and even, and ask about the grade, since finer hats cost more.

name: Otavalo Woven Scarf
about: This is a scarf made in the Andean weaving style of the Otavalo region, near Quito. It reflects the long textile tradition of the Andes.
tip: Ask whether the scarf is wool or acrylic, since the fiber affects warmth, feel, and price.
